title: Factorized option identity × sequence-position role codes
hypothesis: A shared motor core with additive option and position Views preserves heldout option-position combinations and unseen four-step sequences while reducing complete bytes versus an independent option×position bank and beating native additive coefficient controls.

world.teacher: shared orthogonal core plus rank-2 atoms with coefficient c(option,position)=option_code+position_code
world.heldout: six fixed four-option sequences with previously unseen option-position pairings

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed after exact native additive-factor alias or any quality/storage gate miss.

success_gate: heldout nRMSE <=0.02, >=25% fewer complete bytes than independent, and strict frontier gain over native additive factorization.
failure_gate: FAIL if quality/storage gate misses or native additive factors match outputs, bytes, and compute.

compute.mac_proxy: 64 shared-core MAC + 2*D*rank coefficient application per action

boundaries: Synthetic linear maps only; no learned or physical motor policy claims.
Option and position IDs are known and included in payload.
No fresh seeds after development failure or exact native alias.
